scientific_integrity: Analytical spectral-projector proof for all symmetric designs in the stated range; separate rational-arithmetic finite checks corroborate five instances. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted adjacency continuous-time quantum walks on incidence graphs of symmetric designs, with block size at least two and four adjacency eigenvalues. General association-scheme coverage remains possible. The finite tests are not a proof of the infinite family.
title: Universal Cesàro quantum-mixing spectrum of symmetric-design incidence graphs
